test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 09 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: A, B and C starts at the same time, from the same point and in the same direction to run around a circular ground. A completes a round in 240 sec, B in 300 sec and C in 160 sec. After how much time will they meet again at the starting point?
solution:
**Given:**

A completes a round in 240 sec

B completes a round in 300 sec

C completes a round in 160 sec

**Concept:**

Time taken for all to meet again at starting point = LCM of times taken by each to complete a round

**Calculation:**

LCM(240, 300, 160) = 2400 sec

⇒ 2400/60 = 40 min

**Therefore, A, B and C will meet again at the starting point after 40 min.**
